tools: the project's Maven wrapper (./mvnw, Maven 3.9.6); Linux x86_64 with gcc/g++, cmake, ninja, go, perl, rustc/cargo, autoconf/automake/libtool (reference build: gcc 11.5.0, cmake 3.22.2, ninja 1.10.2, go 1.26.8, rustc/cargo 1.99.1, Amazon Linux 2023; the crates cargo resolves at build time may need a current stable Rust, e.g. from rustup, if the distribution's is older)
commands: cd src && MAVEN_OPTS=-Xmx2g ./mvnw -B -ntp -DskipTests -DboringsslBranch=main -pl codec-classes-quic,codec-native-quic -am clean package
notes: Reactor: netty-incubator-codec-parent-quic, codec-classes-quic, codec-native-quic (project version 0.0.71.Final-SNAPSHOT). Same goal as the project's Linux CI/release build (./mvnw -B -ntp clean package on JDK 8), tests skipped. The native module clones BoringSSL and quiche and builds them: the pom pins boringsslCommitSha b8c97f5b4bc5d4758612a0430e5c2792d0f9ca7f and quicheCommitSha 4ff56ec2566622980bbb0e0d7b9217254d97c4ba, and hawtjni-maven-plugin builds the JNI library with autotools; the linux profile links -static-libstdc++ (libstdc++-static). -DboringsslBranch=main: the pom clones BoringSSL with --branch master, which BoringSSL has renamed to main; the pinned commit is checked out either way (only the native jar's MANIFEST header BoringSSL-Branch changes). quiche has no Cargo.lock at that commit, so cargo resolves its crates from crates.io at build time and a later rebuild may resolve newer semver-compatible crates (the reference build's lock had sha256 859b06e2c5b6a74ba951b6d462c715526a72bd0662fa71150f3ba6f9b2be635d). The native jar (classifier linux-x86_64, so the build must run on x86_64) has no classes, so its classes_sha256 does not cover META-INF/native/libnetty_quiche_linux_x86_64.so (reference sha256 123c4171cc242d3744f56ffd45656b6e4af524d142f780b4adf4cb1dacd43721). Fixed: the classes jar and the linux-x86_64 native jar of 0.0.71.Final (coordinates with classifier).
